Cc: procurement@hightide.ai
Date: 2028-05-10T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal question — retainer conversion to committed capacity

Hi Jonas,

We're approaching our renewal window for the retainer covering inference usage. Over the past 12 months our consumption has grown steadily (attached is a simple export of Q1–Q4 usage). The exec team is interested in converting the retainer into a committed capacity contract so we can get predictable unit pricing and a short-term price guarantee while we scale.

High-level ask: can Redwood provide 12-month price protection for a committed capacity purchase that represents roughly a 30% uplift from our current run rate? We care about:
- A guaranteed per-token (generation) unit price for 12 months
- Clarity on overage billing and burst capacity
- Any one-time credits or offsets to make the transition smoother

Procurement and finance will be involved — looping procurement in so they can share any PO/process constraints. Can you share a proposal and indicative pricing by EOM May 15? Also, if there's a standard amendment template you prefer, please send it.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of ML Ops
Hightide Labs

Attachments: Hightide_usage_q1-4.csv (CSV, 48KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@hightide.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal question — retainer conversion to committed capacity

Hi Alicia — thanks for the data, that helps a lot. Short answer: yes, we can structure a committed capacity amendment with a 12-month price guarantee. I'll outline two fast options here and attach a draft amendment for your procurement to review.

Option A (growth-anchored):
- Commit = current run rate + 30% (annualized)
- Discount = 15% off current published unit rates
- Price guarantee: 12 months, no upward repricing within the term
- Overage: billed at published pay-as-you-go rates; 30-day lookback to convert sustained overage into next-term commit
- One-time onboarding credit: $25,000 applied to month 1 invoice

Option B (conservative):
- Commit = current run rate + 15%
- Discount = 10%
- Price guarantee: 12 months
- Overage credits: quarterly reconciliation with potential bill credits for sustained usage shortfalls

Attached: proposed-amendment-HT-042.pdf (draft amendment with SOW and billing table). If you can confirm which option aligns with Hightide's appetite, we'll finalize numbers and generate DocuSign paperwork.

I'll schedule a 30-minute call for early next week to walk procurement through the amendment unless you'd prefer asynchronous.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-amendment-HT-042.pdf (PDF, 92KB)

Jonas — appreciate the clear options. Michael (CC'd) will want to see the financial impact but our preference is Option A if we can get the 12-month price guarantee and the onboarding credit. A couple of quick procurement questions before we lock:

1) Can Redwood guarantee the 15% discount for the full 12 months even if we sign a multi-year MSA extension?
2) Is the onboarding credit applied as an invoice credit or as an implementation services credit?
3) SLA: we're looking for 99.9% inference availability on dedicated endpoints used for our production pipelines. Can you point to the SLA language?

If procurement is comfortable, we'll route the amendment to our legal and finance next week. We prefer DocuSign for signature.

Thanks — Alicia

On a related note, procurement@hightide.ai: please advise any PO numbering requirements or vendor master setup notes so Marissa/finance can include them in the returned paperwork.
